dedupe_keys.name: annual electricity and gas consumption and production by commune or iris as re published on local open data portals

description: Annual electricity and gas consumption and production by commune or IRIS, as re-published on local open data portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 17 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 25 datasets on 17 portals hold annual electricity and gas consumption, thermosensitivity and production by sector, commune or IRIS zone, published by the French network operators and re-published or filtered to a local area on the portals listed here. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Agglopolys, Blois (Loir-et-Cher), Dunkirk urban community, Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne), Grand Soissons Agglomération). The copies sit on: data.82amenagement.fr, data.blois.agglopolys.fr, data.dunkerque-agglo.fr, data.grandparissud.fr, data.mulhouse-alsace.fr, data.orleans-metropole.fr, data.paysdelaloire.fr, data.sicoval.fr and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/), Licence Ouverte v2.0 (. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
